summary: Changes tax_for to return None for unknown regions instead of zero tax.

findings.title: None return breaks checkout and receipt callers
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total adds that value to an int, and tax_line divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout raises TypeError for every order from an unlisted region. Receipt printing also raises TypeError for those orders.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions, or update both callers to handle None before using the result.

findings.title: New unknown-region branch has no covering test
findings.problem: The repository contains no tests. No test covers the new None return for unknown regions.
findings.consequence: Regressions in tax_for and its callers can reach production unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with known and unknown regions.
